results.description: Iran’s Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps (IRGC) Navy announced that it has seized an American Remus 600 autonomous underwater vehicle (UUV) in the Strait of Hormuz. results.title: Pope urges protection of weakest at French shrine at Lourdes known for miraculous cures
results.description: Pope Leo XIV has doubled down on his opposition to euthanasia and medically assisted dying to Lourdes. The French Catholic shrine is associated with miraculous cures and is now also a place of healing for survivors of clergy sexual abuse. During his homily, Leo denounced the “current trends that seek to redefine the value of human life in illness, suffering and old age.” Lourdes became a major pilgrimage destination after the Catholic Church officially recognized visions of the Virgin Mary reported there by a young girl in 1858.
